title: Remove FCA deviation report from sutra_review
description:
Outcome of sutra/236 validation (Josh approved): the FCA deviation report produced a 100% false-positive rate over 5 weeks of live reviews, cited only to be dismissed, never fixed. Remove it from sutra_review.

SCOPE (review only — leave describe_patterns/observed_patterns until the orient delete/realign decision lands):
- Remove ReviewFindings::deviations field (src/tools/review.rs).
- Remove the detect_deviations call from the review build path.
- Remove detect_deviations + Deviation struct + MAX_DEVIATIONS from src/conventions/engine.rs (verify no other caller first — grep confirms review is the only consumer).
- Risk score: remove the `deviations` factor (weight 0.2, ceiling 5.0) from the _explain block and the score formula. CONTRACT CARE (per CLAUDE.md refactor-contract note — risk scoring has silently drifted 3×): renormalize the remaining weights (blast_radius .3, churn .15, complexity .2, hotspot_overlap .15) to sum to 1.0, and update every test asserting an old risk score.
- Tests to remove/update: deviations_appear_in_output, constraints_and_deviations_are_structurally_distinct, deviations_increase_risk_score (tests/review-test.rs).

VERIFY: cargo test green; run sutra_review on a diff and confirm no deviations key and a sane renormalized risk score.

Keep attribute extraction + FormalContext core intact (may serve future constraint authoring).
execution_record: Landed on main as 0387673; cargo test 1575 passed / 2 ignored / 0 failed (verified twice by me, not just the agent). Implemented by a Sonnet subagent; I inspected the diff and re-ran tests rather than trusting the report. Scope grew beyond the original file list during verification — all doc-contract drift caused by the removal: (1) src/tools/help.rs — the entire "conventions" help topic advertised review's FCA deviation detection + a `deviations` output section that no longer exist, so removed it; also fixed the recipes-topic reference. (2) src/rules.rs — the [conventions]-block deprecation message and doc comment pointed at "the on-the-fly deviation report" as the replacement, now itself removed; reworded to point at hand-written [[constraint]] rules. (3) tests/explain-test.rs — two tests iterated the removed `deviations` weight key. The agent also removed the recommended_reads_ranks_violation_sites_first test and the `violation_site` field from recommended_reads entries (justified: deviations were their sole driver; grep confirmed no other producer/consumer). describe_patterns/observed_patterns + FormalContext core intact for orient (pending sutra/312 deletion).

messages.author: agent
messages.text: Review (vidhi-review, diff 913f800..b5952ba covering 312+313): approve with notes. Deviation report cleanly removed from review.rs, engine.rs, and tests. Risk-score contract-care honored per CLAUDE.md: remaining weights renormalized by 1/0.8 (blast .375, complexity .25, hotspot/churn .1875) summing to 1.0, with rationale comment; test asserts the new closed-form. cargo test 1545 passed. Note (medium): docs/conventions-map.md still documents the `deviations` review output contract, Deviation type, risk_breakdown.deviations, and MAX_DEVIATIONS=5 — all removed here. Doc drift landed in the seam between 313 (code-only) and 312 (orient-focused doc edits). Follow-up recommended.
